name: skee-mask-terminal
north_star: Adam's Skee Mask: the dark, sparse, PURE-TONE dub side (Terminal Z model) — NOT the granular-noise dense IDM side
reference: Skee Mask · Terminal Z (B min, 99 BPM, centroid 940 Hz, flatness 0.0011, 2.1 onsets/s — dark, sparse, melodic)
caption: A dark, spacious dub techno track built from a deep, swelling sub bass and sparse, broken 2-step drums. A melancholy melodic line in pure, dark analog synth tones echoes through dub delay, leaving long tails of space between phrases. Layers of warm tape texture and distant, evolving ambient pads create a vast nocturnal atmosphere. The arrangement is patient and hypnotic, developing through subtle textural shifts and a slow swell of intensity rather than density, before dissolving back into echoes.
caption_note: prose rebuilt in the captioner's dialect (its Terminal Z caption caught the ambient build — window at 30s lands before the groove; re-window with --offset 120 for the body); dark/sparse/pure-tone north star kept
script:
[Intro - deep sub and distant echoes]
[Verse - sparse 2-step groove, dark melody]
[Build - dub delays swell]
[Chorus - sub bass blooms, full groove]
[Breakdown - echoes and tails only]
[Verse - groove returns, darker]
[Outro - dissolves into delay tails]
